structure: Single HS course document (Psychology, 0.5 credit, grades 9-12). Then KPE pages: strand SS.1 statement repeated at top of each page, component heading (Perspective and Research, Biology and Behaviors, Conditioning Learning and Cognition, Personality and Individuality), KPEs coded SS.1.PSY.n; 'Teacher Note:' blocks are examples.
